intro: Whisker has discontinued the Litter-Robot 3 Connect in favour of the Litter-Robot 4. Its light codes are not the same as the newer model's, so do not use a Litter-Robot 4 guide to read them. Whisker still publishes support for the Litter-Robot 3, and that is where to go for model-specific fixes. General problems are covered on our common troubleshooting page.

facts.text: Discontinued. Whisker's support centre remains the authoritative source for this model.
